description: Reference Model for an Open Archival Information System (OAIS)

entities.name: OAIS Archive
entities.description: The complete OAIS archive system

entities.name: Ingest
entities.description: Provides the services and functions to accept Submission Information Packages (SIPs) from Producers and prepare contents for storage and management

entities.name: Archival Storage
entities.description: Provides the services and functions for the storage, maintenance and retrieval of Archival Information Packages (AIPs)

entities.name: Data Management
entities.description: Provides the services and functions for populating, maintaining, and accessing both Descriptive Information and administrative data

entities.name: Administration
entities.description: Provides the services and functions for the overall operation of the archive system

entities.name: Preservation Planning
entities.description: Provides the services and functions for monitoring the environment of the OAIS and providing recommendations to ensure that the information stored remains accessible over the long term

entities.name: Access
entities.description: Provides the services and functions that support Consumers in determining the existence, description, location and availability of information stored in the OAIS

entities.name: Receive Submission
entities.description: Accepts SIPs from Producers and performs quality checks

entities.name: Quality Assurance
entities.description: Validates the quality of SIPs and ensures completeness

entities.name: Generate AIP
entities.description: Transforms SIPs into AIPs for long-term preservation

entities.name: Generate Descriptive Info
entities.description: Extracts or creates descriptive information about the content

entities.name: Coordinate Updates
entities.description: Coordinates updates to Archival Storage and Data Management

entities.name: Receive Data
entities.description: Receives AIPs from Ingest for storage

entities.name: Manage Storage Hierarchy
entities.description: Manages the storage hierarchy and migration between storage levels

entities.name: Replace Media
entities.description: Manages media replacement and refreshing

entities.name: Error Checking
entities.description: Performs routine error checking and data integrity verification

entities.name: Provide Data
entities.description: Retrieves and provides AIPs to Access function

entities.name: Administer Database
entities.description: Administers the database systems

entities.name: Query Database
entities.description: Executes queries against the database

entities.name: Generate Report
entities.description: Generates reports from database information

entities.name: Receive Database Updates
entities.description: Receives and processes database updates from Ingest and Administration

entities.name: Negotiate Submission Agreement
entities.description: Negotiates submission agreements with Producers

entities.name: Manage Configuration
entities.description: Manages system configuration and software

entities.name: Manage Archive
entities.description: Manages archive operations and policies

entities.name: Physical Access Controls
entities.description: Manages physical access to the archive facility

entities.name: Customer Service
entities.description: Provides customer service to Producers and Consumers

entities.name: Activation Requests
entities.description: Processes requests for activating archived data

entities.name: Monitor Designated Community
entities.description: Monitors the knowledge and requirements of the designated community

entities.name: Monitor Technology
entities.description: Monitors changes in technology and storage media

entities.name: Monitor Product
entities.description: Monitors the condition and accessibility of archived products

entities.name: Develop Preservation Strategies
entities.description: Develops strategies for long-term preservation

entities.name: Develop Preservation Plans
entities.description: Develops detailed preservation plans

entities.name: Develop Migration Plans
entities.description: Develops plans for migrating data to new formats or media

entities.name: Coordinate Access Activities
entities.description: Coordinates access request processing

entities.name: Generate DIP
entities.description: Generates Dissemination Information Packages from AIPs

entities.name: Deliver Response
entities.description: Delivers responses and DIPs to Consumers

informationPackages.name: SIP
informationPackages.description: Information package delivered by the Producer to the OAIS for use in the construction of one or more AIPs

informationPackages.name: AIP
informationPackages.description: Information package consisting of the Content Information and associated Preservation Description Information (PDI), preserved within an OAIS

informationPackages.name: DIP
informationPackages.description: Information package derived from one or more AIPs and sent by the OAIS to the Consumer in response to a request

roles.name: Producer
roles.description: The role played by those persons or client systems that provide the information to be preserved

roles.name: Consumer
roles.description: The role played by those persons or client systems that interact with OAIS services to find preserved information of interest and to access that information

roles.name: Management
roles.description: The role played by those who set overall OAIS policy as one component in a broader policy domain
